name: Endpoint Defence and Hardening
summary: Reducing the attack surface machine by machine: hardened configuration, endpoint protection and patching kept up to date.
prerequisites: Requires attacks and threats — you harden against something you can name.
syllabus: Jump servers, access control and workstation segmentation
topics: Operating system hardening: unnecessary services, accounts and features
Secure configuration guides (CIS Benchmarks) and automation
Access control by MAC and by NAC (802.1X)
Antivirus and antimalware: signatures, heuristics and limits
Sandboxing and running suspicious files in isolation
Honeypots and honeytokens: detection by bait
Jump server and controlled administrative access
Vulnerability management: scanning, prioritising and deadlines
Patching: window, testing, rollout and exceptions
Inventory and configuration as the basis of any defence
File and URL analysis: VirusTotal, urlscan, any.run, Joe Sandbox and WHOIS
